topic.title: Before You Learn Entries, Learn These Four Trading Foundations

research.summary: Before focusing on entries, build four foundations: market structure, context, risk management, and psychology. These determine how you interpret a setup, how much exposure you take, and how you behave when the market does not cooperate. A good education should connect all four instead of teaching an isolated pattern as a shortcut.
